propositions: Both review gates cannot distinguish clean execution from failed, cancelled, skipped, budget-shed, or resumed work outcomes; an effective-policy snapshot cannot fix those execution facts
A new discovery submodule must define immutable plans and typed per-unit outcomes (success, resumed, skipped, shed, failed, cancelled) independent of the existing verify/decide/coach kernel

The executor must own dependency-aware scheduling, deterministic budget shedding (ascending dependency rank then unit id), usage accumulation, and cancellation observation without reusing workflow/executor.py

A versioned digest-complete checkpoint envelope whose identity covers material, code, effective-policy, prompt, contract, model, topology, dependencies, and namespace version must round-trip only success and content-identical resumed units

Stored trace serialization must contain normalized outcome metadata and lineage while excluding raw prompts, ticket bodies, provider responses, and secrets; public review result schemas remain unchanged
